text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Tunnel E-Power: infrastructure de recharge pour une logistique de transport durable.", "gist": "Tunnel E-Power is a charging infrastructure for sustainable transport logistics."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Galliker Transport AG", "gist": "Galliker Transport AG, a family-owned company"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "«Nous pensons aux générations futures»", "gist": "The company's motto is \"We think of future generations\""}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Chez Galliker Transport AG, il ne s’agit pas d’une simple maxime, mais de la recette qui fait le succès de l’entreprise depuis plus de 100 ans.", "gist": "At Galliker Transport AG, this motto is not just a saying but the secret to the company's success for over 100 years."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "troisième génération", "gist": "the third generation of the family"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "l’entreprise familiale sait que des visions à long terme et des objectifs durables sont indispensables pour pouvoir remettre entre les mains de la prochaine génération une marque bien établie dont elle poursuivra le développement.", "gist": "The family business believes long-term visions and sustainable goals are essential to pass on a well-established brand to the next generation."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Green Logistics Galliker", "gist": "Green Logistics Galliker, the company's strategy"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "l’entreprise familiale s’engage à pratiquer une action durable et à avoir une attitude respectueuse envers l’homme, la nature et l’environnement.", "gist": "The family business commits to sustainable practices and respectful attitudes towards people, nature, and the environment."}]}
